# GradeDate

> Dating for 18–35s that works differently: upload up to 5 photos, get honest AI feedback and your best-pic pick, see your city percentile, then match with people who look similar, in your area.

## About

GradeDate helps people build and understand their dating profile — not judge it. The AI grades each photo on a 1–10 scale, recommends the strongest profile picture, and shows a city percentile so you know where you stand. Your feed is 80% people in your appearance range and 20% outside it, so matching stays realistic: appearance-based and location-aware. The grade and percentile are private to you — other members see your photos and profile, never your grade or biometric data.

The closed beta is Austin, TX first with a capped, invite-only cohort; the waitlist emails you when your city opens. Beta signups include 14 days of Premium free, and every account is age-verified with a government ID (document + selfie). Photo and message moderation is enforced, and CSAM, underage content, and human trafficking are zero-tolerance: content is immediately hidden, accounts locked, and authorities notified.

## Pricing

- **Free tier** — $0/month: 3 likes per day, 1 free regrade per week, up to 5 profile photos, browsing, and messaging.
- **Premium** — $5.99/month (USD): premium likes, regrades, booster, and see-who-liked-you.
- **Founders Club** — the first 1,000 Premium subscribers lock in $5.99/month for life (numbered badge; cap and price lock enforced server-side).
- **One-time upsells** — re-grade credit $0.99, 7-day Profile Boost $2.99, 5 Extra Likes $0.99.
